title: Much Ado About Nothing
subtitle: 30th Summer Season · Directed by David Frederick Mold
description: Celebrate 30 seasons with Shakespeare's sparkling comedy in 19th-century Sicily — romance, wit, and a merry war of words under the stars. VIP pre-sale April 7–14; general tickets on sale April 15. Park opens at 5pm. Tuesdays June 16 & 23 are Pay-What-You-Will. No shows Mondays.
location: Pinkney Park, 177 Rowayton Ave, Norwalk, CT

title: Shakespeare for Kids
subtitle: Education Tent · In the Park
description: Bring Shakespeare into your classroom and catch Shakespeare for kids in the park! Visit our education tent before select performances for Shakespeare in 30 Minutes — a family-friendly half-hour version of our MainStage show, 30 minutes before showtime.
